values.note: 10 wooded drive-in sites for RVs, campers, cars and tents, 6 walk-in tent sites, 2 accessible sites by the river. Only small (under 25 ft) and medium (22-31.5 ft) RVs are recommended because of the tight access road; no pull-throughs. One RV/camper (or 2 tents), 2 vehicles and 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=neri (description, campsites totalSites 16 / tentOnly 6, rvInfo 'There are no pull-through campsites', rvMaxLength 31, regulationsOverview), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Composting toilets only. No camp host on site.

facilities.source: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=neri (amenities: toilets 'Composting Toilets - year round', showers None, potableWater 'No water', dumpStation No, laundry No, campStore No, internetConnectivity No, staffOrVolunteerHostOnsite No), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Run by the National Park Service itself (no concessioner, no host on site). 'All sites are managed on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted.' Campers must occupy their site each night; 14 days in any 28-day period across the park's campgrounds.

booking.source: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=neri (reservationInfo, numberOfSitesReservable 0, regulationsOverview 'Camping limit of no more than a total of 14 days per 28-day period in any park campground'), read 2026-10-21

note: NPS campground with waterfront sites on a sandbar in the New River. --AWH
